ruleDefinitions.name: NetSupport Manager Service Install
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects NetSupport Manager service installation on the target system. Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath, ServiceName

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\\NetSupport\\ Manager\\\\client32\\\.exe.*") OR ServiceName = "Client32"))
